guarantees.claim: wait_timer_prescaler_d is set to all zeros asynchronously when rst_ni is low.
wait_timer_prescaler_d is updated with wait_timer_prescaler_i on posedge clk_i when timer_update is high.

assumptions.claim: When timer_update is asserted, wait_timer_prescaler_i must be a stable and valid prescaler value.
assumptions.risk: The register may capture a glitched or undefined value, corrupting the entropy wait timer configuration.

assumptions.claim: rst_ni must be asserted during power-up to initialize wait_timer_prescaler_d to zero.
assumptions.risk: Without reset, the prescaler holds an unknown value, causing unpredictable entropy timing.

uncertain_points.claim: Verify that timer_update is a single-cycle pulse and that wait_timer_prescaler_i remains stable during the update.
uncertain_points.risk: Multiple or extended assertions could cause unintended writes or race conditions on the prescaler register.

uncertain_points.claim: The reset value of zero for wait_timer_prescaler_d may be insecure; a maximum value might be safer to prevent rapid polling during entropy startup.
uncertain_points.risk: A zero prescaler could allow excessive entropy sampling before configuration, potentially reducing entropy quality.
